scope: evidence update; Oct 30 single-seed dynamic RTL probe and follow-up A/B MODEL_ONLY stages complete

hypotheses.supported_claim: In one four-window probe, generation-time Heavy/Sparse roles survived a physical [0,0,1,1] source schedule, with three effective source-class transitions and Buffer states retaining their prior effective class.
hypotheses.remaining: Multi-seed held-out role-switch confirmation and broader role schedules; do not infer a latency benefit from state counts or one seed.

hypotheses.supported_claim: With arrivals, readiness and all source classes fixed, changing only absolute High credit from 1 to 2 moved the first service-order divergence through refill or eligibility in 3 of 5 arrival phases; 2 phases had no divergence.
hypotheses.remaining: Same-task production RTL refill/eligibility trace and matched quota x ordering x active-set controls under intermittent arrivals; no general latency bound.

hypotheses.supported_claim: Across twenty seeds, 2:1 minus 1:1 increases Sparse P99 by one cycle and mean per-run maximum Heavy wall gap by 1.40 cycles. In held-out MODEL_ONLY under load, mixed minus isolated Heavy completion is 0 cycles (95% CI [0,0]); under over load it is 834.25 cycles (95% CI [820.4,849.3]) and exceeds the predeclared 20-cycle margin.
hypotheses.remaining: Same-task production RTL under/over confirmation, multi-seed dynamic held-out confirmation, broad backpressure/load matrix, and validated same-harness Main/WRR/IWRR contrasts.
hypotheses.scope_note: Seeds are held out from 509-513 exploration but reuse identifiers from an older, different A/B workload. The new quota contrast worsens both tail metrics for 2:1; it does not prove 2:1 dominates.

hypotheses.supported_claim: Under bursty readiness, reducing depth from D16 to D8 moved Heavy P99 waiting from acceptance-to-fire to generation-to-acceptance while total generation-to-fire P99 stayed 20.
hypotheses.remaining: Multi-seed depth confirmation and a broader backpressure/load matrix; component percentiles are not additive and this is not application slowdown.
Calibrated CXL platform or validated system model and actual response/byte/application metrics.
